title: OID patch

kit.description: sample kit played by the sampler engine: a directory of NN_name.wav files (kits/NAME, or the demo kits built in build-host/kits)

macros.description: live controls: macro k is the part's macro k (macro1..macro8, 0..1); each moves its targets from a value to another, in the target's units, along its curve; 32 targets in all

param.description: an engine parameter that moves live, by its role (filter.cutoff)

from.description: its value with the macro at 0

to.description: its value with the macro at 1

module.description: a module's settings: each key a part of a parameter's role, each leaf a value in its units or a label

description: A sound: an engine and its settings grouped by module, {"filter": {"cutoff": 800}, "fx": {"delay": {"mix": 0.2}}}: each leaf's path is a parameter's role (catalog), its value in the parameter's units or one of its labels. Only what differs from the defaults. A patch is the instrument alone: what plays it, its demo, is a clip (clip.schema.json, clips/<name>.json).
